title: Writing / Style / URLs and email addresses
slide_intent: Simplify displayed addresses so people can recognize and reproduce them without unnecessary visual clutter.
strategic_value: Consistent lowercase addresses can help Duolingo keep contact and destination references visually quiet.
demonstration: Three preferred web/email forms appear above versions with protocol prefixes, www or mixed capitalization.
practical_value: Remove the protocol and www from displayed URLs and use lowercase display text for addresses.

reference_purposes.Application: The comparisons cover a root domain, a social-profile path and an email address.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Omit http:// and www. in displayed URLs; use lowercase for the remaining URL and for email addresses.
